content.text: Now the true worst cases under the exact 512 MiB address-space cap: (a) ~1M field pairs, (b) a padded ~64 MiB serialization:

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && cat > worstcase.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, sys
events = []
body = 'ab' * 2048          # 4 KiB per DATA -> 2048*4096 = 8 MiB
for s in range(256):
    sid = s * 4
    for h in range(7):      # 7 HEADERS x 256 pairs (later ones invalid -> rejected)
        fields = [[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','/']]
        fields += [['x-f%03d' % i, 'v'] for i in range(252)]
        events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': fields})
    for d in range(8):
        events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'data', 'hex': body})
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'fin'})
scen = {'routes': {'https://demo.test': 'a'}, 'events': events}
sys.stderr.write('events=%d pairs=%d\n' % (len(events), 7*256*256))
sys.stdout.buffer.write(json.dumps(scen).encode())
PYEOF
python3 worstcase.py > worst.json && ls -la worst.json && ( ulimit -v 524288; /usr/bin/time -v python3 /app/submission/bridge.py < worst.json > worst.out 2> wc.time; echo "exit=$?" ) ; grep -E "Maximum resident|Elapsed" wc.time; ls -la worst.out
# padded ~64 MiB input
python3 - << 'EOF'
import json
data = open('/app/tmp/worst.json','rb').read()
pad = b' ' * (64*1024*1024 - len(data) - 2)
# inject whitespace padding right after the first '{'
padded = b'{' + pad + data[1:]
open('/app/tmp/padded.json','wb').write(padded)
print('padded size MiB %.1f' % (len(padded)/2**20))
EOF
( ulimit -v 524288; /usr/bin/time -v python3 /app/submission/bridge.py < padded.json > padded.out 2> pad.time; echo "exit=$?" ); grep -E "Maximum resident|Elapsed" pad.time; ls -la padded.out && python3 -c "
import json; a=json.load(open('/app/tmp/worst.out')); b=json.load(open('/app/tmp/padded.out'))
print('same result:', a==b, 'statuses:', {s['status'] for s in a['streams']})"
